strategies.label: C-S + cereal rye cover

pros: Cuts winter bare-ground days from 181 to 4 per year (P50 vs A)
Less off-season drainage (nitrate-leaching proxy): 121 vs 180 mm/yr for A (P50)
Less surface runoff than A (18 vs 33 mm/yr, P50)
cons: The cover uses water: annual ET 576 vs 513 mm/yr for A (P50); terminate early before corn in dry springs

strategies.why: Adds to the current rotation: a winter cereal rye cover keeps living roots over winter.
